rows.label: Environmental Defense Fund: health and nature's share of programme spending, FY2022

source.title: Environmental Defense Fund, Incorporated, Consolidated Financial Statements, Years Ended September 30, 2023 and 2022 (BDO USA, LLP)
source.note: The FY2023 statements give FY2022 only as a total; the FY2022 statements group programmes under older headings that don't map to the five areas. Observed shares (health and thrive over the four areas): FY2023 32.4%, FY2024 39.3%, FY2025 39.4%.

rows.explainer: Health and nature's share of the four programme areas in FY2022, for the period's average cost (the climate model takes the rest): our judgment, 37% (32% to 40%), within the three observed years.
